settings.label: Web search
settings.help: Lets Claude search the web and read pages, without asking.

settings.label: Stop when idle
settings.help: The claude process takes about 175 MB; closed this long, it stops, and the next message resumes the chat (a few seconds slower). 0 keeps it running.

settings.label: System prompt
settings.default: You are a quick assistant that lives in the user's desktop notch. Answer briefly and directly, in the language the user writes in. Use Markdown only when it helps: short lists, code blocks.
